name: healthsync
description: HealthSync Indonesia — Integrated Health Platform Monorepo

scripts.deploy: node -e "const {execSync: e} = require('child_process'); e(process.platform==='win32' ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/deploy.ps1' : 'bash scripts/deploy.sh', {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.start: node -e "const {execSync: e} = require('child_process'); e(process.platform==='win32' ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start.ps1'  : 'bash scripts/start.sh',  {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.test: node -e "const {execSync: e} = require('child_process'); e(process.platform==='win32' ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test.ps1'   : 'bash scripts/test.sh',   {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.test:unit: node -e "const {execSync: e} = require('child_process'); e(process.platform==='win32' ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test.ps1 -Unit'      : 'bash scripts/test.sh --unit',      {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.test:integration: node -e "const {execSync: e} = require('child_process'); e(process.platform==='win32' ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test.ps1 -Integration' : 'bash scripts/test.sh --integration', {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.test:coverage: node -e "const {execSync: e} = require('child_process'); e(process.platform==='win32' ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test.ps1 -Coverage'   : 'bash scripts/test.sh --coverage',   {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.docker:infra: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env.dev up -d postgres redis emqx zookeeper kafka mailhog
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env.dev run --rm migrate
